name: Summary metadata is optional, historical, validated and included in change impact
description: Summary metadata is optional, historical, validated and included in change impact.

passage.quote: The summary is an optional summary array in the description’s JSON metadata, with one nonempty text string per bullet. An omitted or empty array means no summary. Loading and CLI inspection return it with the description, including at historical revisions. Validation rejects malformed bullets while keeping the full Markdown readable as a draft. Summary edits use the same file snapshots and affected-description review as other metadata edits.
